page.overview:
Who is Fusion of Ki?

Both of their forms receive incredible boosts in strength, with Goku using Super Saiyan Blue, while Xeno Goku uses Super Saiyan 4 (in the anime and OVA) or Super Full Power Saiyan 4 Limit Breaker (in the manga).

This transformation unifies the energy of both Gokus, forming a flaming white and golden ki around them both while blue and red lightning crackle around Goku and Xeno Goku, respectively. A large halo similar to Chronoa's Time Power Unleashed's own emerges behind them, comprised of two colors - one half being Goku's blue and the other half being Xeno Goku's red.

Chronoa describes the technique as linking two individuals' energy, bringing their combined ki to the max and allowing them to constantly fight at full power. To further increase the technique's effectiveness, individuals must concentrate their attacks towards the same location for greater damage output. However, Fusion of Ki cannot be maintained for long.

In the anime, Goku and Xeno Goku take on this combined energy state when Chronoa helps them form a truly direct link between their ki after Super Saiyan God SS Evolved Gogeta and Super Full Power Saiyan 4 Limit Breaker Xeno Gogeta are defused by Dark King Fu. This fused ki state cannot be maintained for long, but the two deliver a powerful Combined Kamehameha that pierce through Fu's protective barriers and makes contact, though Fu remains relatively undamaged while the two Gokus drop out of the Fusion of Ki state.
